dedupe_keys.name: an adaptable different levels cascaded h bridge inverter analysis for pv grid connected systems

description: Adnan Hussein Ali and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented MATLAB/Simulink application compares cascaded H-bridge inverter configurations with five, seven and nine voltage levels for photovoltaic grid integration. It evaluates harmonic distortion and switching-related performance under the stated simulated operating conditions. These implemented electrical models support power-quality assessment of the named conversion topology. The abstract does not establish hardware field validation, universal distortion levels, a complete utility network model or downloadable source files. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
